text:
maya li: quick follow-up from todaylead Q&A: teams need a compact timeline and owner list for API / Console / Optimize. can leadership confirm?
jess carter: short: API GA (early Aug), Console beta (late Sep, invite), Optimize v1 (Nov). owners: API=jess carter, Console=sasha, Optimize=rafael (eng-ml).
tom (eng-infra): i need the code freeze windows to schedule kernel/AMI rotations and capacity buys.
jess carter: tentative freezes: API 2026-08-01..2026-08-14, Console 2026-09-16..2026-09-29, Optimize 2026-11-02..2026-11-15. will lock after one-pager.
sasha (product): gating highlights: API GA requires 48h staging stability at 99.9% + zero regressions on core evals. Console beta needs RBAC, audit-logging, and two pilot signoffs. Optimize needs quantization profiles + cost-savings report >=15% on sample loads.
maya li: will there be an automated fallback when models hit latency targets, or is that opt-in?
jess carter: fallback routing = opt-out for enterprise tiers, opt-in for self-serve. controlled by tenant feature-flag.
tom (eng-infra): rollback question: how many packaged variants do we need to keep ready? we need build capacity.
jess carter: keep two fallback families per model (quantized + full). that's what infra should plan for.
sasha (product): action item: product will publish a one-page summary with owners, dates, gates, and a tiny FAQ by EOD Friday.
ci-bot: Created TASK-7782 "Publish release one-pager: API/Console/Optimize" assigned to sasha, jess carter, due 2026-07-09.
maya li: thanks. one more from sales/legal: any migration-assist changes for Dedicated customers and EU data residency during Console beta?
jess carter: migration assistance SLA unchanged; concierge window expanded for beta pilots. residency terms unchanged. details in one-pager and SOW templates.
maya li: great, i'll circulate to PMs and infra once the one-pager lands. :rocket:
